name: Mohtava Marketing Publisher
author: Mohtava Marketing

sections.description:
The Mohtava Marketing Publisher plugin is a powerful tool that integrates smoothly with the Mohtavamarketing platform. This third-party service enables you to create, manage, and publish a variety of content on your website. With this plugin, you can effortlessly prepare and publish guest posts, review articles, suggested content, and advertorials.

Motava Marketing is the third-party platform that the Motava Marketing Publisher plugin relies on. It offers a user-friendly interface for content creation for your website. In this platform, the quality of content, the speed of project delivery, and compliance with the goals and wishes of the customer are our main
To ensure you comply with legal requirements regarding data transmissions, please review and follow the terms and conditions outlined in Mohtavamarketing Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the wp-content/plugins/mohtava-marketing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Mohtava Marketing Settings screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Follow any additional instructions provided to successfully integrate the plugin with your Mohtava Marketing account.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free to use?

Yes, the use of the plugin is free.

How do I get a Mohtava Marketing account?

You need to create an account at Mohtava Marketing platform. Visit their website and follow the registration process.
